descriptionFull: The broad-winged hawk ( Buteo platypterus ) is a small hawk of the genus Buteo . During the summer, some subspecies are distributed over eastern North America, as far west as British Columbia and Texas; they then migrate south to winter in the neotropics from Mexico south to southern Brazil.
